definition.name: Create U Stairs From Runs
definition.description: Creates U-shaped stairs between two levels from two straight run paths and a rectangular half landing (mm).
definition.aiDescription: Creates U-shaped stairs between two levels from two straight run paths and a rectangular half landing (mm). Runs with manual transactions (its own transactions and edit scopes, one undo step).
examples: create U-shaped stairs between these levels

inputs.name: typeName
inputs.description: Stair type to use; created when missing.

optionalInputs.name: baseType
optionalInputs.description: Stair type copied when the type is missing.

optionalInputs.name: maxRiserMm
optionalInputs.description: Maximum riser of a new type in mm.

optionalInputs.name: commentPrefix
optionalInputs.description: Text written before the stair name in Comments.
